title: 5 ChatGPT Codes That Explain Any Topic Better Than a Teacher
description:
Hi! 👋

I put all 100 codes into one clean doc, sorted by category so it's easy to actually use 👇
https://docs.google.com/document/d/1ijaRTn4CfgN2904Db-YV04SJNyomCd7FDgZVCxltKfk/edit?usp=sharing

The 5 study codes from this video are in there too:
✅ Turn any topic into handwritten notes
✅ Break it down with diagrams and visuals
✅ Compress a full chapter into short revision points
✅ Instant flashcards
✅ Quiz you and show exactly where you're weak

One word before your topic. That's it.

Save it, use it daily, your ChatGPT game levels up 🚀

Which code hit hardest? Tell me in the comments 💜

— Aashi 💕
